summary: Comprehensive architectural rebuild specification and 100% feature inventory for the Noorul Islam Madrasa System across Native Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose), Native iOS (Swift + SwiftUI), Responsive Web (Next.js + Tailwind CSS), NestJS backend services, and Firebase Firestore/Auth/Cloud Functions. Contains complete traceability matrix, database schemas, RBAC matrix, and phase-by-phase rollout roadmap.
